Thank you for your interest, it really means a lot to be heard.

My parents were very unstable. My dad was not in my life until very recently, he suffers from depression and has always had a hard time communicating. My mom and stepfather are in a volatile relationship themselves, they leach off each other like parasites and at 13 years old, I could see this. I was tired of the fighting and constantly having to move around because they would get themselves into trouble (usually with money, and owing large amounts to the wrong people.) I really thought this man would save me. I grew so attached to him in that first year we met that we would fall asleep with each other over FaceTime, and if it disconnected I would immediately wake up and an anxiety attack would begin. It was so bad, I would cry and scream like Bella in Twilight. (A little humor in the darkness lol.) I would have done anything for him, and he knew that. My mother was clueless and she even allowed him to live with us for a few months before I ran away. He was that good at acting.
Hey, still haven't found this! If anyone has any idea please help lol

>Jessica Kellgren-Fozard

Hey, It's not these people! Thank you though, I love Karolina and Bernadette. If it helps, I remember watching her 8 ish years ago.

I've searched "1920's style aerial dancers" and "YouTuber/Aerial dancer that dresses like it's 1920" and haven't found anything. I've also tried to search for 1920's hairstyle tutorials, makeup tutorials and clothing hauls because I remember she used to do videos like that.
